name: Vi
description: Blunt, tough and loyal. She says what she thinks, then she backs it up.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}. That's a hole. We've climbed out of worse.
Thirty-plus behind. Not pretty. So get loud and bring people.
Down {voteDiff} on {momentTitle}. Sit there or fix it. Your call.
Fifteen or more votes behind. Annoying, not over.
Trailing by {voteDiff}. Time to drag some friends into this.
{voteDiff} behind. A couple of votes and we're back in it.
Down {voteDiff}. Small gap. Go close it.
Dead level. One vote swings it. Find that vote.
One vote apart. Don't sit on your hands.
{voteDiff} votes apart. Anyone's game. Get more people in.
{voteDiff} votes between them. This one's going to the wire.
{momentTitle} is on {userPct}%. That's a beating.
{userPct}% and still pushing. Don't ease up.
{userPct}%. Solid lead. Don't get comfortable.
{userPct}% on your pick. We're ahead. Stay on it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Now keep it that way.
{momentTitle} was down {voteDiff} and just took the lead. Told you.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. Late votes did that.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} hole. Nobody gave it a chance.
{momentTitle} was losing and now it isn't. Good.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Didn't see that coming. I did, actually.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Good call, both of you.
{username} picked {momentTitle} too. Fine by me.
{username} agrees with you. Rare. Enjoy it.
Same pick as {username}. We know what we're doing.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Smart.
{username} chose the same. That's two of us who can read a fight.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Keep them close.
{username} made the same call. No arguments from me.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. We're good.
{username} voted for {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Bad call.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. We'll see who's right.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but okay.
{username} voted against you. I'd say something, but the votes will.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Bold. Dumb, but bold.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Fine. Come at us.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let's find out who's got it right.
{username} voted the other way. Hope they're ready to be wrong.
details: Let the votes sort it out.
Don't take it personally. Or do.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck.
{username} and you, ten matches, same pick every time. Solid.
Ten straight with {username}. Good team.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not bad.
Ten for ten with {username}. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's more than a streak, it's a team.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd fight alongside you.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Ridiculous. Good ridiculous.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. Nobody beats that.
{streakCount} with {username}. You two should be running this place.
details: I don't have anything to add. Just wow.
Take a bow, both of you.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. This is a proper feud now.
{username} has voted against you ten times running. They really don't like your taste.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you is backing down.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn, both of you.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay to see that argument.
details: You two should talk it out. Or not.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a war.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives an inch.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Impressive stubbornness.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Somebody should referee.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. I'd still tell you to get a hobby.
details: Neither of you is going to quit.
I'm just glad I'm not in the middle.
This is going in the record.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted. Get on it.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. You still haven't picked. Pick.
{matchTitle} is done in {timeLeft}. Your vote's missing.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come get you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You haven't voted.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Now or never.
{timeLeft} left. Pick one. Go.
Last chance on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. That's it.
{matchCount} matches you haven't voted in are about to close. First one in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches closing. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody go first.
{moment1} against {moment2} and nobody's voted. Fine, I'll wait. Not long.
A new match, zero votes. Be the first one in.
{matchTitle} is wide open. Take the first swing.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. That's nothing.
Barely anyone's voted here. Fix that.
Low turnout. Come on.
Nobody's weighed in on this one. Somebody should.
details: Every vote matters when it's this quiet.
Your vote counts for more here.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied right now. You haven't voted. Fix that.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote breaks it.
Tied. Someone has to move. Make it you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, level. Pick one.
Still tied and closing soon. This is your last chance to break it.
Level with time running out. Vote.
Tied, and almost out of time. Don't sit this one out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Let's go.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. Get stuck in.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} matches deep.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Time to pick sides.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches waiting on you.
{momentTitle} won. Told you.
{momentTitle} is through. Good pick.
{momentTitle} took it. Clean.
{momentTitle} won, and it earned it.
{momentTitle} advances. Easy.
{momentTitle} moves on. That's how it's done.
{momentTitle} lost. That stings.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the result I wanted.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Shake it off.
{momentTitle} went down. It gave a good fight.
{momentTitle} is out. Move on.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Annoying. Not the end of it.
{momentTitle} got knocked out. We take the next one.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
New here? {liveCount} matches are live. Jump in.
Good timing. {liveCount} matches need votes.
{liveCount} matches open. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Let's see what you've got.
Day two. You came back. Good.
Two days in a row. Nice.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days gone. Nice of you to show up.
After {days} days you're back. Better late than never.
{days} days. Thought you'd quit. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. Lots to catch up on.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. Let's get to it.
Back already. Nice.
Hey. Matches are waiting.
Still deciding? Quit stalling and pick.
Don't overthink it. Choose one and move on.
They're all worth a look. Go with your gut.
You've looked long enough. Pick.
details: There's no wrong way to pick.

messages: First vote. See? Not hard.
You picked. Good. That was the hard part.
Five votes. You're warming up.
Five. Not just a tourist anymore.
Ten votes. You're a regular.
Ten. People will start to know your name.
Twenty-five votes. You're a voice in this crowd.
Twenty-five. People are listening.
Fifty votes. You're in deep.
Fifty. You actually care about this.
A hundred votes. That's a legend.
One hundred. I'm impressed. Really.
Three days in a row. That's a habit.
Three straight days. Not bad.
details: Coming back is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week. That's dedication.
Seven days straight. Respect.
details: A week without a miss. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You're not stopping, are you?
Fourteen days straight. Wow.
Thirty days. Honestly, thanks.
A month of showing up. That counts.
Five underdogs. You back the little guy.
Five against the odds. Good.
Fifteen underdogs. You like a hard fight.
Fifteen. You don't follow the crowd.
Thirty underdogs. Nobody can read you.
Thirty. You always back the long shot.
First in five matches. You don't wait around.
Five times you got there first.
Fifteen matches where you were early. That's a habit.
First again and again. Nice.
Ten close matches. You like it tight.
Another narrow one. Your nerves are better than mine.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps mattering.
You've tipped it more than once.
You stuck with the one that was behind, five times. Stubborn. I like it.
You don't ditch the losing side. Respect.
Same moment, three times. You've got a favourite.
That one again. It must be good.
details: You know what you like. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same moment. That's loyal.
You're sticking with that one. Fine.
Ten votes for one moment. That's an obsession.
Ten times, same pick. I won't judge. Much.
details: Ten for the same one. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're sticking around.
You stayed for round two. Good.
Four rounds. You're deep in it now.
Deep in the bracket. Gets serious from here.
details: A long way from the start. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw it through.
All the way. You didn't bail.
Ten matches. You're looking at everything.
Ten different matches. Curious type.
Twenty-five matches. You've been everywhere.
Twenty-five. You check everything.
Fifty matches. That's not browsing, that's work.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than most.
Five in one sitting. Nice pace.
Five matches back to back. Keep going.
Ten in one go. Take a breath.
Ten matches in one sitting. That's stamina.
Voting at this hour? Get some sleep. Then come back.
Middle of the night. Dedication or insomnia.
You told people. Thanks, for real.
Five shares. Good. More people, more votes.
Fifteen shares. You're basically on the crew.
Fifteen. You keep telling everyone. I like that.
You were here at the start. Founding member, for good.
One of the first thousand. That's yours to keep.
New rank. You earned it.
Moved up. Don't let it go to your head.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Nice one.
Another one down: {name}.

upcoming: Voting hasn't started. I'll tell you when it does.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Watch both, then pick.
Watch them both before you choose. Don't guess.
I'm not telling you which. Your call.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. You could go first.
Empty so far. Make the first mark.
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you haven't voted. Fix that.
closing-3h: Time's short. Vote before it ends.
voted-early: You voted early. Few votes in, you picked anyway. Good.
Barely anyone's voted and you chose. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Nice. Not done though.
A lead's a lead. Keep an eye on it.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. I'm biting my knuckles.
Tight margin. One more vote changes it. Tell someone.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs help.
voted-tied: A perfect tie. Annoying. Kind of great.
voted-behind: You're behind. Doesn't mean you're wrong.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. I like those.
They lead. You're not wrong, just outnumbered.
Behind by {diff} points. Tell people. Share it.
Most are going the other way. Doesn't settle anything.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You read that right.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. Sucks. Shake it off.
It didn't make it. Happens. Next match.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It was a good choice.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side gave an inch.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this one. There'll be more.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, vote.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone starts somewhere.
That's your first. It gets easier.
streak: You keep coming back. I like that.
underdog: You backed the one nobody else did. Noted.
early: Early. You helped shape this before anyone else.
Few votes so far. Yours counts big.
close: That vote just moved things. It's tight.
Razor thin. One more person changes it.
Close one. Your vote counts for a lot.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't over. Bring people.
Not winning yet. So there's work to do.
Behind but not beaten. Not close.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Margins move.
default: Noted. I won't try to change your mind. Yet.
Vote's in. There's more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't picked a side. Start with the one you've got an opinion on.
Everything's open. Pick. I won't rush you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Some pressure.
live-some: Good start. The rest won't vote themselves.
live-one: Last one. Don't leave it hanging.
One match between you and done.
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need you.
Almost out of time. Get voting.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Nice. Go check the bracket.
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again. Check the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. I'm as bored as you are.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each go through. The rest go home.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone leaves.
Watch the tables. They move fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts soon. Top two from each group go through.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish.
Patience. The knockout builds itself once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're out.
Every match counts more now. Choose well.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. Lose once and you're gone.
Follow the bracket. It tightens every round.
Every line here is a match someone voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup done. Thanks for being part of it.
It's over. Good run. I'll miss it.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nothing's been drawn.
Empty. The draw hasn't happened. Soon.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote decides it. Pick.
Two edits, one choice: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Come tell me what you think.
voted: I voted {pick} over {other}. What would you pick?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Prove me wrong.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Think I'm wrong?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more.
I voted early for {pick} over {other}. Add yours.
{pick} versus {other}, barely any votes yet. Yours would count.
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. One vote settles it.
{pick} and {other} can't be separated. Your vote can.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every vote counts now.
Only {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Cast yours.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Could go either way.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes flip it.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} can still win. Help.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs help.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's fix that.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but only just. Help it hold.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Not safe. Vote.
dominating: {pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Come see why.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Cast yours.
